window: 4 AM Fri 30 Oct to 4 AM Sat 31 Oct IST
headline: Aadarsha Kutumbam led yesterday with 217K tickets, up 130% on the day before, with Jailer 2 second at 119K.
bullets: Aadarsha Kutumbam took the top spot with 217K tickets, up 130% from 94.2K the day before, and its busiest hour was 6:33 PM at 14.52K.
Jailer 2 was second with 119K tickets, up 38% on the day before, though it is down 68% on the same day last week.
Namit Malhotra's Ramayana had 39.5K tickets, up 38% on the day before, and it gained the most interest at +15K in 24 hours; bookings are open for its Thu 5 Nov release.
Avengers: Doomsday has 468K+ people interested (+8K in 24 hours), but bookings are not open yet for its Thu 17 Dec release.
Prahaar was the lowest of the eight tracked films at 7K tickets, down 58% on the same day last week.
